name: Drum and dome
_about: A DOME ON A DRUM, the crown of a church: a drum of `n` bays with a window in every `every`th, a dome of any profile on it, a lantern standing on the dome where it has narrowed to the lantern's width (`atopR`), and -- asked for by name -- ribs up the dome and a PERISTYLE of columns round the drum (and, by name, the `peristyle deck` from the drum out to them). Place it at the top of whatever carries it (a crossing's pendentives, a church's roof ring); R is the drum's inside radius.

params._R: the drum's inside radius -- a crossing's pendentives' circle; dt its wall, H its height, n its bays (a window every `every`th)
params._profile: the dome's section, any profile (semicircular, pointed + spread, segmental + rise, onion + bulge/neck, bell + waist/lift)
params._lanternR: the lantern: it stands on the dome where the dome has narrowed to its radius
params._pw: the peristyle (build it by name): a ring of columns round the drum, pw out from it, and the deck they carry

drum._about: the drum, a window every `every`th bay...

drum piers._about: ...and the piers between (leave them out when every bay has its window: `every` 1)

ribs._about: ribs up the dome, one per bay (build it by name)

lantern._about: the lantern, standing on the dome where it has narrowed to the lantern's width

peristyle._about: a ring of columns round the drum, carrying a deck -- St Paul's, the Pantheon in Paris (build it by name)

peristyle deck._about: the deck over the colonnade, from the drum out to the columns' line (the entablature caps only the columns: no broad ring overhangs them)
